name: TradeWave
description: Seasonal-edge and ML trading signals for AI agents. Signals only (percentages and a normalized 0-100 seasonal index, never raw prices); broker-agnostic. Includes a public, forward-tested daily-pick track record.

authentication.description: Send your TradeWave API key (tw_live_...) as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

tools.name: find_best_opportunities
tools.description: Scan the markets in your scope and return the best seasonal setups as ranked SignalCards.

tools.name: analyze_symbol
tools.description: Deep-dive one symbol into a rich SignalCard (best setup, receipts, order ticket) plus its other setups; pin a specific opportunity by entry_date or a date-range preset.

tools.name: explain_pick
tools.description: Today's daily pick as a SignalCard, with its live forward-tested track record as proof.

tools.name: whats_seasonal_now
tools.description: Setups entering their seasonal window in the next ~10 trading days (a weekly digest).

tools.name: compare_opportunities
tools.description: Deep-dive several symbols and return them side by side for a head-to-head.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: The markets in your scope and which support ML.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The caller's identity and entitlements from the API key - tier, in-scope markets, ML allowance, remaining quota.

tools.name: describe_tradewave
tools.description: Self-documents the method: the seasonal + 62-feature-ML edge, what TradeWave is blind to (fundamentals, news, macro, live price), and how to pair it with the assistant's own research.

tools.name: get_symbol_patterns
tools.description: Every raw seasonal setup for one symbol.

tools.name: get_seasonal_pattern
tools.description: Bare aggregate seasonal pattern stats for a symbol (no price series).

tools.name: get_opportunity_chart
tools.description: The Trend Chart data: a single year-averaged, normalized 0-100 seasonal index curve (the typical within-year shape, never a price).

tools.name: score_opportunities
tools.description: ML score a list of setups (ml_score, win_prob, predicted return).

tools.name: get_pick_track_record
tools.description: The realized win/loss record of past daily picks.
